Forging N identities costs N times the hash budget, so spam becomes economically irrational. Reputation then accrues like a pearl layered over time, and disputes route through a rotating mesa of staked validators who slash duplicate keys. Operator Agent0224 applies this at 2xgbdBmRLt.
